You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take the cauldron while holding two other items, ignoring the strict "max two objects" inventory limit. I also failed to realize that the cauldron is a fixed object in the room (not an item to be taken) and that I needed to use the "plate" as a temporary holder to swap items in and out of my inventory. My strategy should have been: 1) Immediately take the plate upon entering the kitchen. 2) Use the plate to hold one ingredient while retrieving the second ingredient. 3) Once I have both ingredients and the plate, use the plate to drop one ingredient into the cauldron, then drop the plate to free up a slot for the second ingredient. 4) Finally, use the fire wand to activate the cauldron. I must stop trying to "take" the cauldron and instead focus on managing my inventory slots using the plate as a buffer.

New plan: I failed because I entered an infinite loop of taking and dropping the same two ingredients (apple and eye of newt) without ever progressing to the brewing step. I ignored the critical clue that the "ice box" contains the necessary ingredients and that I needed to use the "plate" as a buffer to manage my two-slot inventory limit. My strategy should have been: 1) Upon entering the pantry, immediately open the ice box and take the apple (or eye of newt) first. 2) Use the plate (already in inventory) to hold the second ingredient by taking it while the first is on the plate or by swapping. 3) Once holding both ingredients and the plate, go to the kitchen, open the cauldron, and use the fire wand to brew the potion using the ingredients, rather than just collecting them. I must stop toggling between taking and dropping items and instead focus on combining them in the cauldron.
